items.title: HUBB Q3 deep dive: Data center strength offsets utility softness, capacity investments shape outlook
items.summary: Electrical and electronic products company Hubbell (NYSE:HUBB) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 24.6% year on year to $1.87 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $5.91 per share was 2.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Hubbell (HUBB) Stock Falls After Q3 Earnings Lift Guidance
items.summary: Hubbell just delivered Q3 2026 numbers with double digit sales expansion to about US$1.9b and adjusted earnings per share of US$5.91, yet the stock dropped 5.5% on the day to US$434.28. That is a sharp move for an industrial infrastructure supplier that also lifted full year adjusted EPS guidance to US$20.40 to US$20.60. Short term emotion is in control.
